description: The Rajasthan government has introduced an advanced facial recognition system powered by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enhance security and streamline administrative processes across the state. This innovative technology is now being utilized in various sectors, including examination verification, law enforcement, and citizen identification. The deployment aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of identification procedures, reducing the reliance on traditional methods such as ID cards and manual verification. During examinations, AI-driven facial recognition ensures the rightful candidates are seated and prevents impersonation, thereby maintaining the integrity of the exam process.
